summary: Retest of the Pagamenti fornitori fixes from iteration 57. All 6 fixes are verified. Backend: tests/test_iteration57_pagamenti_fornitori.py was updated to the new behaviour and extended; 36/36 pass with -n 0. (1) A PUT on the PG entry of a distinta that includes a partita_aperta fornitore, sent with its saldaconto links, now returns 200. The 3 recreated payments keep distinta_pag_id. (2) A PUT without saldaconto returns 400 ('...annulla la distinta da Pagamenti fornitori'); the entry is unchanged and all 4 payments are kept. (3) Changing A2 from 574.93 to 500 (righe 1000/1000) recalculates pag_distinte: totale 1000, n_partite 3, n_bonifici 1, disposizioni 1000, modificata_prima_nota true, partite per invoice. The CBI CtrlSum and InstdAmt are both 1000.00, the scadenze residuo A2 is 74.93, and annulment still reopens every partita. (4) GET saldaconto/registrazione returns one row per invoice with the summed importo (A1 300+100 gives 400). (6) Two parallel POSTs for the full residuo of B1 return 200 and 400, with no double payment. UI (Playwright 1920px): the Prima nota badge 'Pagamenti fornitori' has bg-violet-50 text-violet-700 (fix 5). In the edit dialog of a distinta paying A1 rata 300 + 50.50 and a partita aperta of 100, the Abbina input shows 350.5 and PA shows 100, with 'Abbinato 450,50 €'. Saving gives the toast 'Registrazione salvata', and the DB keeps distinta_pag_id with the snapshot unchanged (450.50). Quick regression of /pagamenti-fornitori: clear al, select a row, partial amount '200,25' (comma), totale 200,25 €, Registra, toast 'Distinta 2/2026 registrata ... prima nota n. 5/2026', Distinte tab lists both distinte. All TEST_T57 data deleted (verified 0 leftovers).

minor.issue: The serialization lock is a per-process asyncio.Lock. It works with the current --workers 1, but not if production runs several workers or replicas; a DB-level guard (e.g. a findOneAndUpdate lock document) would be safer.

If the user changes the Avere bank account in the PG entry, pag_distinte.conto_banca and banca_iban are not updated, so the CBI still uses the original bank. ricalcola also keeps rata_n from the first old partita per invoice (per-rata detail lost after an edit). Neither is blocking.

issues: No visual marker that a distinta was changed from Prima nota (modificata_prima_nota). Suggest a small 'modificata' badge so the user knows to re-download the CBI file.
The Data field uses the native browser date input instead of the shadcn calendar (existing, not new).

action_items: Optional: replace the in-process asyncio.Lock with a DB-level lock if multiple workers are used in production
Optional: show a 'modificata in prima nota' badge on distinte; sync conto_banca if the bank row changes
critical_code_review_comments: pagamenti_fornitori.crea: the locks defaultdict grows without bound per company (negligible)
upd_reg: sc.remove runs before the coa_entries update and sc.apply. An exception in apply or ricalcola after check would leave the entry without payments (no try/restore around apply)

The previous minor points still apply: the counter gap on a prima nota insert failure, prima[0] in the rata message, the DbtrAgt MmbId fallback for non-IT IBANs, and the frontend num() thousand separators
seed_data_creation: TEST_T57 companies, users and sessions, suppliers, invoices, a partita aperta and distinte were created and then deleted. No other data was touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_iteration57_pagamenti_fornitori.py -v -n 0. For UI: cd tests && python ui_setup_iter58.py setup, which prints the ids, RUN and TOK and creates distinta D1 (A1 300+50.50 + PA 100). Use cookie session_token=TOK and localStorage fe_company_id=cid. Clean with python ui_setup_iter58.py clean RUN.
